text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I walk through the hall, I see Haru
Urara
heading my way, looking
stressed...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My head is pounding... It feels like when
I eat too
much ice cream...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I think I'm seeing stars...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Haru Urara is suffering from
a
headache.
